newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Leader Steel proposes issues.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Leader Steel proposes issues.

text.p: Leader Steel Holdings Bhd said it was proposing a bonus and a rights issue in the ratio of two shares for every five held.
It said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange it was also planning a 60 million ringgit bond issue, sale of 15.998 million warrants to shareholders and an employees' share option scheme.
Commerce International Merchant Bankers Bhd said on behalf of the company that the proposed bonus and rights issues involved 7.999 million new one ringgit shares each.
The rights issue price was proposed at 4.70 ringgit per share.
The merchant bank said Leader Steel proposed to issue 60 million ringgit nominal value five-year zero percent to four percent Redeemable Bank Guaranteed Bonds with 15.998 million detachable warrants.

Proceeds from the issues totalling 97.596 million ringgit would be used to acquire land and factory building (27.3 million ringgit), purchase plant and machinery (49.15 million ringgit), invest in Vietnam (2.2 million ringgit), meet working capital requirement (17.146 million ringgit) and for issue expenses.
